Name: Hidden Haven Farm
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
so basically this is just a very small map based on [url=https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/3/30/Hidden_Grotto_interior_Winter_B2W2.png]hidden grottos!![/url](like the one from pokemon games) added as a new custom farm so it doesn't replace any vanilla farm maps, a barn and a coop should be placeable and theres also a dedicated space for a stable infront of the forest entry,

i recommend playing this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url] mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25942]Entrance to Narnia[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25435]Cozy Backyard﻿[/url] if you want more farming and building space

this should be﻿ compatible with any recolors cuz i used the vanilla tilesheets, if its not then youre A loser

u get strawberry seeds, seed maker, fish smoker, and bait maker as a gift instead of 15 parsnips

Downloads.Description:
- fixed winter tiles
- new icon and finally working worldmap:33
